newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Southern, Barlow top trade.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Southern, Barlow top trade.

text.p: Big trades in Southern Life Ltd, which saw shares worth N$2.9 million trade, and Barlow Ltd which traded stocks worth N$2.6 million, dominated activity on the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSE) last week, dealers said.
Large trade was also seen in investment trust Genbel South Africa.
During the week a total of 338,387 shares worth N$7.8 million changed hands.
The NSE overall index ended the week at 236.29 up from the previous week's close of 234.16. The NSE local index was virtually unchanged at 154.34 fom 154.03 before.
